summary: Completed backend testing of Centro de Control EDARSA Email Notifications. All 14 tests passed. SMTP connection to mail.edarsa.com.mx:587 is working correctly. Email sending fails with 550 'No Such User Here' because the configured recipient (admin@edarsa.com.mx) doesn't exist on the mail server - this is expected behavior as noted in the requirements.

minor.issue: Email sending fails with SMTP error 550 'No Such User Here' - recipient admin@edarsa.com.mx doesn't exist on mail server
minor.note: SMTP connection IS working. This is a configuration issue with ALERT_EMAIL_TO in .env - needs a valid email address on the EDARSA mail server

action_items: LOW: Update ALERT_EMAIL_TO in backend/.env with a valid email address that exists on mail.edarsa.com.mx server
critical_code_review_comments: Email notification service correctly implemented with async sending via ThreadPoolExecutor
SMTP connection to mail.edarsa.com.mx:587 with TLS is working correctly
All email endpoints properly protected with authentication (get_current_user dependency)
Email config endpoint correctly masks recipient emails for security (shows 'adm***@edarsa.com.mx')
Error handling is comprehensive - returns detailed error messages including SMTP errors
HTML email template is well-designed with responsive layout and severity-based colors
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email notification system fully tested. Key findings: 1) SMTP connection to mail.edarsa.com.mx:587 works correctly. 2) Email sending fails because recipient admin@edarsa.com.mx doesn't exist on mail server (550 error). 3) All endpoints protected with authentication. 4) GET /email/config returns configured:true, enabled:true. 5) To fix email delivery, update ALERT_EMAIL_TO in backend/.env with a valid email address.
